dct_description_sm: NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) system provides visualizations of NASA Earth Science observations through standardized web services. These services deliver global, full-resolution visualizations of satellite data to users in a highly responsive manner, enabling visual discovery of scientific phenomena, supporting timely decision-making for natural hazards, educating the next generation of scientists, and making imagery of the planet more accessible to the media and public.
